prompt:

Asset type: Meshy single-object image-to-3D reference for CATHEXIS — detached mechanical facial insert, GRIMACE expression.

Input roles: Image 1, the approved Grace mask, is the EDIT TARGET for the object's outer oval silhouette, compact face-sized mounting envelope, tapered chin, slim brass perimeter and paired small temple fastening points. Image 2, CATHEXIS's maskless full-body front reference, supplies only the dark articulated brass-and-black FACIAL machinery seen inside her face, its refined mechanical construction, cheek/brow plates and metallic teeth. Do not reproduce the whole robot or whole head.

Transform the porcelain face insert from Image 1 into ONE COMPLETE DETACHED MECHANICAL FACE INSERT. It must be a thin, shallow face assembly that could occupy the SAME oval face mount as the porcelain mask. Complete forehead-to-chin and cheek-to-cheek assembly, compact integrated brow, nose bridge, cheeks, mouth and chin — NOT just a floating jaw or a fragment. Replace the entire visible porcelain surface with darkened articulated facial machinery and fine aged brass fittings inspired by Image 2. Keep a continuous slim oval mounting rim and the small left/right temple mounting points.

Expression: a clearly DISTORTED ASYMMETRIC THEATRICAL GRIMACE — strained, contorted, unpleasantly expressive. One inner brow plate cranks sharply downward toward the nose while the other brow arches under tension. One cheek mechanism hikes upward; the other draws down. Segmented mechanical lip rails pull the mouth sideways into a crooked pained grimace, exposing staggered rows of individually fabricated metallic teeth; one corner compressed, the other pulled outward and downward. The jaw and cheek linkages visibly account for the deformation. The outer oval mount stays level, symmetric and undeformed. Convey expressive theatrical facial articulation, not a generic permanently smiling skull. No symmetrical grin, no cartoon laugh, no beauty smile.

Eyes: exactly TWO EMPTY HOLLOW EYE OPENINGS framed by the expressive mechanical brow and cheek rails. Show unobstructed plain gray background clearly through each hole. These are genuine open apertures with no eyeballs, no pupils, no irises, no lenses, no amber lights, no glowing eyes, no backing plate or head behind them.

Mechanical design: layered blackened metal facial plates, restrained aged brass edges, readable small pivot joints, cheek sliders, brow hinges and taut local linkage rods; machined metallic teeth and a thin articulated metal nose bridge. Controlled functional detail at face scale. No anatomical bone texture, no human flesh, no skin, no generic skull cranium, no empty skull nasal cavity. This is an engineered expressive robot facial insert from CATHEXIS, using her original materials and refined construction.

Framing: strictly straight-on centered front view, level camera, left and right outer mount equally visible, no three-quarter perspective or head tilt. One isolated object floating against plain neutral medium gray studio background. Full outer contour and all fastening points visible with generous margin. Soft even diffuse studio lighting, sharp readable material surfaces, coherent high-detail realistic 3D asset render.

Absolute exclusions: NO whole head, NO rear skull volume, NO crown, NO headset, NO ears, NO hair, NO neck, NO cables hanging below the chin, NO torso, NO human wearer, NO eyeballs or lights behind the eye sockets, NO second mask, NO props, NO exploded view, NO text, NO UI, NO labels, NO border, NO watermark. One detached facial insert only.

This is a design-intent image for later modeling. Preserve the approved mounting envelope visually; do not imply measured mechanical compatibility, identical topology or UVs.
